Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Great talking earlier — thanks for walking through your current pipeline and the key success criteria. Per our notes, the high-level goals for the eval are:

- Validate throughput and p99 latency for your 1.5k requests/hour baseline (target p99 < 150ms on 2k token avg).
- Confirm integration paths for API + SSO and an embeddings pipeline for semantic search.
- Establish a prompt set and automated evals to track quality vs. your existing model.

I pulled a short trial plan together (attached) that proposes a 3-week evaluation with a kickoff technical deep-dive, a week of integration, and end-of-trial quality & cost review. The doc also lists required access/whitelisting items and sample prompt sets.

Proposed times for a 60-minute kickoff (technical deep dive + success criteria alignment):
- Tue, Apr 6 — 10:00–11:00 AM PT
- Tue, Apr 6 — 3:00–4:00 PM PT
- Wed, Apr 7 — 9:00–10:00 AM PT

Can you confirm which one works and who from your team should join (SRE/Platform, Product, Data)? Also, if there are any mandatory compliance items we should pre-load (SSO domain, IP allowlist), please let me know.

Attachments: redwood-trial-plan-acme-20260401.pdf, acme-prompt-set-sample.csv

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Thanks Marissa — that plan looks good. We can do Tue, Apr 6 at 10:00 AM PT. Attendees from our side: myself (Product), Rajiv (SRE), and our ML lead Priya (cc’ed on calendar invite once confirmed).

Our top-line success criteria so the team is aligned:
1) p99 latency < 150ms for 2k token avg (under typical daytime load)
2) Per-token cost at or below our current benchmark (please include your cost assumptions in the trial plan)
3) Smooth SSO integration + minimal changes to our auth flow
4) Embeddings quality comparable to current embeddings for semantic search (we’ll share evaluation benchmarks)

Could you add a ~10-minute agenda to the invite and share the prompt set you want us to test? Also confirm whether you need IP allowlisting details ahead of time.

Appreciate it — see you Tuesday.
